notes: Tuition: DAAD page states 1,500 EUR per semester for non-EU applicants; the RWU financing pages say 1,500 EUR per semester for all students who do not come from the EU, so the fact is stated as 300,000 EUR per year. Semester fee (224 EUR first semester, 215 EUR afterwards) is not tuition and is left out. Documents list comes from the RWU programme page; the RWU page requires only a true certified copy of the university entrance qualification, civil documents are not required. Intake: the RWU page gives the application period 01 September - 31 October but no year for the deadline; the RWU dates page gives 1 September - 31 October 2026 for the summer 2027 intake of the English-language Bachelor's programmes, which includes Electrical Engineering and Information Technology (EN); English-language Bachelor's programmes apply directly through the RWU portal, including applicants from third countries. For applicants with a foreign (non-EU) secondary diploma whose certificate is not ANABIN-recognised, the written entrance examination is required (TestAS/ITB/SAT/ACT) plus a 30-minute oral exam in English; a Studienkolleg route at Konstanz applies only to German-language programmes. Anabin compliance and grade thresholds are left as manual checks. No winter intake: 'There is no winter intake for this study program.' The teaching languages are quoted from the DAAD page; the RWU page says the same.
